# ===== MAKE A DOCUMENT REGISTER =====
# Paste everything below into a "Run Shell Script" action in Shortcuts.app.
# Shell: /bin/bash   |   Pass input: as arguments
# The shortcut receives a FOLDER.

export LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8
run() {
  /usr/bin/python3 - "$1" <<'PYEOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Document Register generator - stdlib only.
# Builds a .docx by injecting a register table into the spA letterhead template.
import os, sys, re, io, base64, zipfile, datetime, html

FONT = 'KMR Waldenburg Halbschmal'

def natural_key(s):
    return [int(t) if t.isdigit() else t.lower() for t in re.split(r'(\d+)', s)]

def parse(name):
    if '_' in name:
        m = re.match(r'^\s*([^_]+)_(\S{1,2})\s+(.*\S)\s*$', name)
        if m:
            return m.group(1).strip(), m.group(3).strip(), m.group(2).strip()
        m = re.match(r'^\s*([^_]+)_(\S{1,2})\s*$', name)
        if m:
            return m.group(1).strip(), '', m.group(2).strip()
        return '', name.strip(), ''
    m = re.match(r'^\s*(\S+)\s+(.*\S)\s*$', name)
    if m:
        return m.group(1).strip(), m.group(2).strip(), ''
    return name.strip(), '', ''

def collect(root):
    groups = []
    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
        dirnames[:] = sorted([d for d in dirnames if not d.startswith('_')], key=natural_key)
        rows = []
        for fn in filenames:
            if fn.lower().endswith('.pdf') and not fn.startswith('.'):
                num, title, rev = parse(os.path.splitext(fn)[0])
                rows.append((num, title, rev, fn))
        if not rows:
            continue
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: (natural_key(r[0]) if r[0] else [chr(0x10ffff)], natural_key(r[3])))
        is_root = os.path.abspath(dirpath) == os.path.abspath(root)
        label = None if is_root else os.path.basename(dirpath)
        groups.append((label, rows, is_root, os.path.relpath(dirpath, root)))
    groups.sort(key=lambda g: (0,) if g[2] else (1,) + tuple(natural_key(g[3])))
    return [(g[0], g[1]) for g in groups]

def esc(t):
    return html.escape(t, quote=True)

def rpr(color=None, sz=None):
    p = f'<w:rFonts w:ascii="{FONT}" w:hAnsi="{FONT}" w:cs="Arial Unicode MS"/>'
    if sz:
        p += f'<w:sz w:val="{sz}"/><w:szCs w:val="{sz}"/>'
    if color:
        p += f'<w:color w:val="{color}"/>'
    return f'<w:rPr>{p}</w:rPr>'

def para(text, sz=None, color=None, after=40):
    return (f'<w:p><w:pPr><w:spacing w:before="0" w:after="{after}" w:line="240" w:lineRule="auto"/></w:pPr>'
            f'<w:r>{rpr(color, sz)}<w:t xml:space="preserve">{esc(text)}</w:t></w:r></w:p>')

def cell(text, shade=None, width=None):
    shd = f'<w:shd w:val="clear" w:color="auto" w:fill="{shade}"/>' if shade else ''
    w = f'<w:tcW w:w="{width}" w:type="dxa"/>' if width else ''
    return (f'<w:tc><w:tcPr>{w}{shd}<w:vAlign w:val="center"/></w:tcPr>'
            f'<w:p><w:pPr><w:spacing w:before="20" w:after="20"/></w:pPr>'
            f'<w:r>{rpr()}<w:t xml:space="preserve">{esc(text)}</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc>')

def span_header(text, shade='E7E6E6', ncols=3, width=9000):
    return ('<w:tr>'
            f'<w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:w="{width}" w:type="dxa"/><w:gridSpan w:val="{ncols}"/>'
            f'<w:shd w:val="clear" w:color="auto" w:fill="{shade}"/></w:tcPr>'
            '<w:p><w:pPr><w:spacing w:before="40" w:after="40"/></w:pPr>'
            f'<w:r>{rpr()}<w:t xml:space="preserve">{esc(text)}</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc>'
            '</w:tr>')

def build_table(groups):
    widths = [1600, 6300, 1100]
    t = ['<w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblW w:w="9000" w:type="dxa"/>'
         '<w:tblBorders>'
         '<w:top w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:color="BFBFBF"/><w:left w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:color="BFBFBF"/>'
         '<w:bottom w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:color="BFBFBF"/><w:right w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:color="BFBFBF"/>'
         '<w:insideH w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:color="BFBFBF"/><w:insideV w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:color="BFBFBF"/>'
         '</w:tblBorders></w:tblPr>']
    t.append('<w:tblGrid>' + ''.join(f'<w:gridCol w:w="{w}"/>' for w in widths) + '</w:tblGrid>')
    hdr = ['<w:tr><w:trPr><w:tblHeader/></w:trPr>']
    for h, w in zip(['Drawing No.', 'Drawing Title', 'Rev'], widths):
        hdr.append(cell(h, shade='BFBFBF', width=w))
    hdr.append('</w:tr>')
    t.append(''.join(hdr))
    for label, rows in groups:
        if label is not None:
            t.append(span_header(label))
        for i, (num, title, rev, fn) in enumerate(rows):
            shade = 'F5F5F5' if i % 2 else None
            row = ['<w:tr>']
            for val, w in zip([num, title, rev], widths):
                row.append(cell(val, shade=shade, width=w))
            row.append('</w:tr>')
            t.append(''.join(row))
    t.append('</w:tbl>')
    return ''.join(t)

TEMPLATE_B64 = ""

def build_docx(path, folder_name, groups):
    total = sum(len(r) for _, r in groups)
    date = datetime.date.today().strftime('%d %b %Y')
    content = [para('Document Register', sz=28, after=60),
               para(f'{folder_name}  •  {total} documents  •  {date}', sz=18, color='666666', after=160),
               build_table(groups)]
    content_xml = ''.join(content)
    tpl = base64.b64decode(TEMPLATE_B64)
    zin = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(tpl))
    doc = zin.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')
    head = doc[:doc.index('<w:body>') + len('<w:body>')]
    sect = re.search(r'<w:sectPr\b.*?</w:sectPr>', doc, re.S).group(0)
    newdoc = head + content_xml + sect + '</w:body></w:document>'
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for item in zin.infolist():
            data = zin.read(item.filename)
            if item.filename == 'word/document.xml':
                data = newdoc.encode('utf-8')
            zout.writestr(item, data)

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print('usage: register.py <folder>'); sys.exit(1)
    folder = os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1])
    groups = collect(folder)
    outdir = os.path.join(folder, '_document register')
    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
    out = os.path.join(outdir, datetime.date.today().strftime('%y%m%d') + '_Document Register.docx')
    build_docx(out, os.path.basename(folder.rstrip('/')), groups)
    print(out)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

PYEOF
}
process() {
  out=$(run "$1")
  [ -n "$out" ] && /usr/bin/open -R "$out"
  /usr/bin/osascript -e 'display notification "Register created" with title "Document Register"' >/dev/null 2>&1
}
if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
  for f in "$@"; do process "$f"; done
else
  while IFS= read -r f; do [ -n "$f" ] && process "$f"; done
fi
